title: Travel Document Expiry Runway
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=travel:document
| stats latest(days_until_expiry) as days_until_expiry by document_type person
| where days_until_expiry>=0 AND days_until_expiry<90
| sort days_until_expiry
description: Uses Travel document trackers telemetry to monitor how much runway remains before travel documents expire in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for passports or permits that need attention before they block a trip, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Travel document trackers data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Document table of days until expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how much runway remains before travel documents expire so you can spot passports or permits that need attention before they block a trip before it becomes annoying.
